title: Design System: Valued Resident — An Idle Wasteland

display.purpose: Department docket headers and the facility title plate — stencil Bold 26px, tracking +1.25.

headline.purpose: Posted-notice headlines (MAIL CALL, ZONE SECURED) — stencil Bold 24px on paper.

title.purpose: Card titles, button labels, tabs — stencil SemiBold 18px, tracking +1. SectionLabel runs 19px.

body.purpose: Directives and plate sub-copy — Public Sans Regular 15px (dim 14, plate body 13).

label.purpose: Vent serials and section eyebrows — Public Sans SemiBold 12px, tracking +2.5, uppercase.

mono.purpose: Every gameplay number, serial, rate, log line — Courier Prime 17px (serials 13, lists 15, big 26 bold).

shadows.name: enamel-lift
shadows.purpose: Default plate and button shadow — signage lifting off the steel.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Hovered enamel plates and buttons, paired with the amber border.

shadows.name: pressed-settle
shadows.purpose: Pressed buttons; content margins shift down 2px.

shadows.name: amber-halo
shadows.purpose: The energized button's normal shadow — the one warm shadow.

shadows.name: paper-cast
shadows.purpose: Posted paper — asymmetric, like a sheet taped to steel.

motion.name: bulkhead-close
motion.purpose: Riveted shutter slides across the docket on department change (quad ease-in).

motion.name: bulkhead-open
motion.purpose: Shutter slides away (quint ease-out); daylight mouth energy pulses up and back.

motion.name: docket-settle
motion.purpose: New docket settles from 28px offset / 0.35 alpha to home.

motion.name: energized-swell
motion.purpose: Energized plate swells forward from its left-center pivot (back ease-out); boot swell re-asserted after first layout pass.

motion.name: stamp-cadence
motion.purpose: Log lines stamp only on batched engine flushes (250ms min interval) and immediate discrete signals; nothing updates per frame.

motion.name: serial-flash
motion.purpose: Console serial flash (RECORD QUEUED / RECORD FILED) restores the standing serial after two seconds.

motion.name: chalk-dismiss
motion.purpose: First-run START HERE chalk fades on first department change.

components.name: Enamel Plate
components.description: The default bone signage plate: stencil title + mono serial in navy ink on enamel, bolted above the steel.
components.css: .ds-plate-enamel { background: #F2EDE3; border: 2px solid #20334F; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(16,24,41,0.35); padding: 14px 10px; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-plate-title { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 1.25px; color: #20334F; } .ds-plate-serial { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #20334F; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Energized Plate
components.description: The active-state plate: navy ground, 3px amber border, amber title — the live department, swelled forward.
components.html:
>> SCAVENGING
ONE ACTION EVERY 3.0 S
components.css: .ds-plate-energized { background: #20334F; border: 3px solid #FFB000; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(10,18,28,0.55); padding: 16px 12px; } .ds-energized-title { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 1.25px; color: #FFB000; } .ds-energized-serial { font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #FFB000; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Danger Plate
components.description: Danger/cancel/locked: safety-red ground, bone text — gates, death, recall. Red never speaks as text on dark grounds.
components.html:
DECEASED — RETURN TO SHELTER
NOTHING WAS LOST · THE ZONE THANKS YOU FOR YOUR CONTRIBUTIONS (PARTIAL)
components.css: .ds-plate-danger { background: #B3261E; border: 2px solid #F2EDE3; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 5px 10px rgba(24,5,5,0.4); padding: 16px 12px; } .ds-danger-line { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #F2EDE3; } .ds-danger-serial { font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #F2EDE3; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Paper Notice
components.description: Posted bureaucracy taped to the steel: navy ink on paper, red rubber stamp, asymmetric cast shadow.
components.html:
MAIL CALL
GAINS ACCRUED IN YOUR ABSENCE. NO ACTION WAS TAKEN WITHOUT YOU. NONE WAS NEEDED.
POSTED — SECTOR B
components.css: .ds-paper-notice { background: #F2E7CF; border: 1px solid #D9CBA8; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 3px 5px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.32); padding: 16px 12px; max-width: 380px; } .ds-paper-title { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 1.25px; color: #20334F; } .ds-paper-text { font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #20334F; margin-top: 6px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-paper-stamp { font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #B3261E; margin-top: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Button — Default
components.description: The stencled button plate: bone ground, navy stencil. Hover lights the border amber; pressed settles into the steel.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #F2EDE3; color: #20334F; border: 2px solid #20334F; border-radius: 3px; padding: 18px 10px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(16,24,41,0.35); transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #FFB000; box-shadow: 0 6px 10px rgba(16,24,41,0.45); } .ds-btn:active { border-color: #FFB000; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(10,15,26,0.3); transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; border: 2px solid #FFB000; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,176,0,0.9); }

components.name: Button — Energized
components.description: The primary action (BEGIN SHIFT): navy ground, amber stencil, 3px amber border, amber halo. Hover keeps the navy ground (amber-on-navy-hi measured 4.46:1 — under the floor).
components.css: .ds-btn-energized { background: #20334F; color: #FFB000; border: 3px solid #FFB000; border-radius: 3px; padding: 18px 10px; min-width: 300px; min-height: 64px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(255,176,0,0.25); transition: box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-energized:hover { background: #20334F; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(255,176,0,0.4); } .ds-btn-energized:active { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(10,15,26,0.3); transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-energized:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,176,0,0.9); }

components.name: Button — Danger
components.description: Cancel/quit (CLOCK OUT): red ground, bone stencil; hover brightens the red ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #B3261E; color: #F2EDE3; border: 2px solid #F2EDE3; border-radius: 3px; padding: 18px 10px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(24,5,5,0.4); transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #C22F28; border-color: #FFB000; } .ds-btn-danger:active { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(10,15,26,0.3); transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,176,0,0.9); }

components.name: Recessed Input
components.description: The machined pocket: steel-deep ground, asymmetric 2/1px border, amber caret; focus turns the border amber all around.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #3A404A; color: #F2EDE3; caret-color: #FFB000; border: 2px solid #2E333C; border-right-width: 1px; border-bottom-width: 1px; border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 7px; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #D0CEC9; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border: 2px solid #FFB000; }

components.name: Clearance Gauge
components.description: The enamel gauge: recessed track, amber fill, exact numbers in the mono readout beneath — never a percentage.
components.html: CLEARANCE 02 · 20/65 XP TO NEXT
components.css: .ds-gauge-vent { background: #2E333C; border-bottom: 1px solid #6B7482; border-right: 1px solid #6B7482; border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px; } .ds-gauge-track { background: #3A404A; border-top: 3px solid #2E333C; border-left: 3px solid #2E333C; border-radius: 2px; height: 20px; padding: 3px; } .ds-gauge-fill { background: #FFB000; border-radius: 1px; height: 100%; } .ds-gauge-read { font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 17px; color: #F2EDE3; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Stencil Icon Plate
components.description: The icon grammar: 128-unit bone tile, rx 14, 8-unit navy border, round-capped navy linework. Token colors only (bone/navy/amber/red).
components.css: .ds-icon-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview:
The whole game is a bomb shelter's institutional signage system — a bureaucracy that survived the apocalypse and never stopped issuing cheerful directives. The player reads the shelter like a resident following signage: department plates direct to skills, clearance levels gate content, offline gains arrive as a posted MAIL CALL notice, and combat death posts a red RETURN TO SHELTER plate. The system refuses the idle-category default (dark admin dashboard, green XP bars) and its predictable opposite (glowing green CRT terminal).

Materials do the branding: bone-white enamel plates over a rolled-steel ground, institutional navy as the structural ink, riveted panel frames, recessed vent housings, and paper notices taped to the steel. Exactly two colors carry meaning — amber (active/energized) and red (danger/cancel/locked); everything else is ground and ink. Depth is physical, not optical: plates lift off the steel on hard drop shadows, recesses sink into darker ground, and state is never color-alone — the energized plate is amber AND swells forward AND carries a >> text prefix.
keyCharacteristics: Bone enamel over rolled steel; institutional navy ink; two signal colors only (amber = energized, red = danger).
Three typefaces: Big Shoulders Stencil Display (signage caps), Public Sans (body), Courier Prime (all gameplay numbers).
Near-square corners (1–3 px) — institutional form language, never soft UI roundedness.
WCAG-AA on every registered text-on-ground pair, machine-verified at test time.
Physical depth: drop-shadow plates, recessed inputs/vents, beveled riveted frames — no glow, no gradients.
One authored motion: the bulkhead-slide department transition plus the energized swell; log lines stamp in on batched engine flushes, never per-frame.
Full keyboard navigation with a visible amber focus ring; font scale 100/150/200% re-sizes every registered size from one call.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only energized color in the system and it means exactly one thing: live/active. Interaction, focus, gauges, and the energized state all draw from it. Never introduce a second accent, a green success, or a blue info color.

rules.name: The Paper Takes Navy Ink Rule
rules.body: Paper notices carry navy ink (or a red stamp) — never bone text. Paper is the one light ground where the navy ink does the talking.

rules.name: The Red Never Speaks on Dark Rule
rules.body: Red never appears as text or border on rolled steel or navy. Danger posts as a red enamel plate carrying bone text, or as a red rubber stamp on paper.

rules.name: The Registered Pair Rule
rules.body: Any new text-on-ground combination must be added to CONTRAST_PAIRS in scripts/theme/signage_tokens.gd with its AA class and must pass the recomputation in tests/probe_theme.gd. An unverified pair does not ship.

rules.name: The Mono Digits Rule
rules.body: Every gameplay number — XP, rates, currency, stack counts, percentages, gauges, log lines — renders in Courier Prime. If it is a number the player can act on, it is mono.

rules.name: The Stencil Means Signage Rule
rules.body: Stencil caps appear only on issued signage: plate titles, section labels, buttons, tabs. Body copy, paper notices, and directives use Public Sans; the stencil never sets a sentence.

rules.name: The Honest Number Rule
rules.body: Numbers print exactly (integer grouping, no rounding) via SignageFmt; the one sanctioned departure is the ≥10^15 suffix form, which truncates so a displayed value can understate but never overstate the true integer.

rules.name: The Stacked Serial Rule
rules.body: A wrapped serial label stacks as a full-width VBox row. A WORD_SMART autowrap label never sits beside a foreign EXPAND_FILL sibling — Godot starves it to a 1 px vertical column.

rules.name: The Two-Thirds Rule
rules.body: The docket owns the right two-thirds of the concourse; the plate wall never competes with it. The primary action of any docket is its big stencled button, never a toolbar.

rules.name: The Plate Lifts, The Steel Recedes Rule
rules.body: Raised surfaces get a downward drop shadow; sunken surfaces (vents, inputs, gauge tracks) get a darker ground plus a heavier top/left border and never a shadow. The rolled-steel wall itself is perfectly flat.

dos: Do build every surface from the theme's StyleBox variations (EnamelPlate, EnergizedPlate, DangerPlate, SteelPanel, VentHousing, PaperNotice) — the concourse probe rejects ad-hoc panels.
Do give every state a non-color cue: >> prefixes, distinct wording, swell, stamp text.
Do render every gameplay number in Courier Prime via SignageFmt (exact integers; truncating suffix form only ≥10^15).
Do post rates and drop tables on the cards themselves ("POSTED RATES ARE THE HONEST RATES") — exact fractions, one decimal only when needed.
Do register any new text-on-ground pair in CONTRAST_PAIRS and re-run the theme probe before shipping it.
Do set label minimums through containers (PanelContainer content margins, CardButton stacks) and wrap long serials with WORD_SMART as full-width rows.
Do keep paper copy in the institutional-bureaucratical-cheer voice, all caps, with rubber stamps ("THE DEPARTMENT THANKS YOU FOR BREATHING ATTENTIVELY.").
donts: Don't use amber as body-size text on rolled steel (4.10:1 — large stencil caps and UI accents only) or introduce any second accent color.
Don't set red text on steel or navy, or bone text on paper — danger posts as a plate or stamp.
Don't use the stencil face for sentences, body copy, or paper notices; never set gameplay numbers in Public Sans.
Don't add glow, gradients, scanlines, or large radii — depth comes from lift shadows and recessed grounds only.
Don't place a wrapped autowrap label beside a foreign EXPAND_FILL sibling (the 1 px collapse class).
Don't update UI per frame; mutate only inside batched flushes and discrete signals.
Don't hand-edit assets/theme/signage_theme.tres — regenerate it via scripts/theme/generate_theme.gd after changing SignageTheme/SignageTokens.
Don't invent untracked colors in scenes or icons; all colors resolve through SignageTokens (the one-off #D9CBA8 paper hairline and #C22F28 danger hover live in the theme builder).
